text:
Maria Gomez: Thinking out loud — can we pilot a lightweight 'closure conductor' for postmortems? short daily owner pokes + a weekly sprintlet to close actions.
Ajay Patel: curious, what does conductor do vs current tracker? :thinking_face:
Maria Gomez: not a new tool, more a role + tiny cadence. conductor = single owner who runs 72h check, weekly sprintlet, escalation to eng-oncall if blocked.
Tanya Liu: love the idea. suggestion: make a 4-step timeline template so owners know exactly what to do days 0/3/7/14.
Leo Chen: +1. can we add a quick `ownership scoreboard` view (owners, due date, blocker flag)? even a Google sheet works.
Priya Rao: also add recurrence detection: if same subsystem shows up twice in last 90d, automatic priority bump and RCA follow-up.
Maria Gomez: exactly. conductor runs the scoreboard and triggers recurrence badge. keeps comms short: day 0 ack, day 3 update, day 7 close or escalate.
Ajay Patel: for incident commander rotation, can conductor be separate from IC? worried about load.
Tanya Liu: yes, separate role. IC focuses on live incident; conductor focuses postmortem closure runway.
devops-bot: deploy reminder set: "conductor-template-v1" -> sends DM to owner at day 3 and day 7
Leo Chen: suggestion for messages: keep Slack pings templated. e.g. 72h DM: "hi <owner>, quick status on PM action #X? blockers?ETA?" simple.
Priya Rao: add an opt-in weekly 30m sprintlet meeting for owners only. low overhead, 3 slots max, rotation by subsystem.
Maria Gomez: action: I’ll draft timeline template and a sample scoreboard sheet. Ajay can you prototype the recurrence flag logic? Tanya, can you help with the templated pings?
Ajay Patel: yep i'll wire up a simple script that tags incidents by cluster and counts repeats over 90d. PR by EOD Friday.
Tanya Liu: will write two ping templates and a one-paragraph owner playbook.
Leo Chen: I'll make the sheet and a view in ops-dashboard for owners.
Priya Rao: schedule proposal: pilot for 6 weeks, engineering services only, then review with SRE and oncall.
Maria Gomez: rolled into plan: pilot start Monday. small group -> owners get DM reminders, weekly sprintlets on Thursdays, conductor rotation every 2 weeks.
Ajay Patel: question: who is on the conductor rota? volunteers or ops-assigned?
Tanya Liu: volunteers first, fallback to oncall lead if no volunteers by Friday.
Maria Gomez: noted. escalation path: owner -> conductor -> oncall lead -> eng manager.
Leo Chen: can we capture metrics: time-to-closure, % actions closed in 14d, recurrence rate change. we'll track in sheet.
devops-bot: reminder: runbook template uploaded -> /docs/incidents/closure-conductor-template.md
Maria Gomez: great. small ask: keep messages short in the pilot. we want low friction. any objections?
Ajay Patel: none from me. :+1:
Tanya Liu: :+1:
Priya Rao: :thumbsup:
Leo Chen: :shipit:
Maria Gomez: thanks team — I'll post the pilot doc and rota sign-up tomorrow.
